verdict.rationale: Clerk documents drop-in `<SignIn/>`, `<SignUp/>` and user-profile/account-dropdown components covering authentication and profile and security settings, with prebuilt UIs listed on its plans (clerk-docs-15, clerk-docs-23, clerk-docs-47, clerk-gh-1). It also documents customizing them to match branding with any CSS library (clerk-docs-18, clerk-docs-33), and a community user praises the Next.js integration and that it covers user management beyond login (clerk-comm-15). missing for 10: explicit documentation of hosted/redirect sign-in pages (only 'deploy to your own domain' is mentioned), independent hands-on corroboration of how deep the UI customization goes.
